name: yorha-legal-ai-frontend
description: YoRHa-styled legal AI frontend with Gemma3 integration - Phase 70 Clean

scripts.packets:sync: npm run packets:export && npm run packets:synthesize && npm run packets:postgres:load && npm run packets:neo4j:edges
scripts.packets:pipeline: npm run packets:export && npm run packets:synthesize && npm run packets:duckdb:reduce && npm run packets:postgres:load && npm run packets:valkey:warm && npm run packets:neo4j:edges
scripts.packets:pipeline:dry: npm run packets:export:dry && npm run packets:duckdb:reduce:dry && npm run packets:postgres:load:dry && npm run packets:valkey:warm:dry && npm run packets:neo4j:edges:dry
scripts.atlas:graph:full: npm run atlas:graph:load:apply && npm run atlas:rewards:populate:apply
scripts.atlas:dry-run: npm run atlas:root:index && npm run atlas:routes:import && npm run atlas:imports:static && npm run atlas:imports:dynamic && npm run atlas:env:map && npm run atlas:engram:sync && npm run atlas:validate
scripts.turbo:trace-smoke: mkdir -p .tmp/audits && opencode run -m turboquant/gemma4-tq --agent trace-audit --format json "Use TRACE MCP first. Call trace_kag_search or search_dev_context for SvelteKit 2 Svelte 5 Drizzle Zod Bits UI audit. If no TRACE tool is available, say TRACE_MCP_NOT_AVAILABLE." | tee .tmp/audits/trace-smoke.ndjson
scripts.bifrost:semantic:sync: npm run packets:duckdb:semantic && npm run bifrost:semantic:warm && npm run bifrost:semantic:verify
scripts.phase8:cache:readiness: npm run qdrant:centroids:sync && npm run cache:semantic:warm && npm run cache:bifrost:verify && npm run phase8:legacy:readiness
scripts.phase8:graph-first:verify: npm run audit:retrieval-comparison && npm run phase8:cache:effectiveness && npm run audit:legacy-atlas-fields && npm run ci:all
scripts.phase8:fortify: npm run phase8:cache:readiness && npm run phase8:graph-first:verify && npm run engram:ranker:upgrade && npm run cache:invalidate:stale && npm run check:fast
scripts.ci:all: npm run check:fast && npm run lint
scripts.atlas:build: npm run ace:startup-health && npm run atlas:root:index && npm run atlas:workspace && npm run atlas:language && npm run atlas:imports && npm run atlas:env && npm run atlas:routes && npm run atlas:qdrant:tag && npm run atlas:neo4j:ingest && npm run atlas:couchdb:mapreduce && npm run graphify:karpathy-batch && npm run atlas:redis:sync && npm run atlas:validate
scripts.atlas:root:full: npm run ace:startup-health && npm run atlas:root:index && npm run atlas:routes:import && npm run atlas:imports:static && npm run atlas:imports:dynamic && npm run atlas:env:map && npm run atlas:qdrant:tag && npm run atlas:neo4j:ingest && npm run atlas:couchdb:mapreduce && npm run graphify:karpathy-batch && npm run atlas:redis:sync && npm run atlas:engram:sync && npm run agents:write && npm run atlas:validate
scripts.test:network-contracts: cd sveltekit-frontend && npx playwright test tests/e2e/contract-network.spec.ts --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:network-contracts:report: cd sveltekit-frontend && cross-env WRITE_CONTRACT_REPORT=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/contract-network.spec.ts --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.atlas:gate:all: npm run atlas:gate:identity && npm run atlas:gate:replay && npm run atlas:gate:lineage && npm run atlas:gate:chr97 && npm run atlas:gate:final
scripts.atlas:ingest:full: node sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/chunk-text-notes.mjs --input ../data/parents-atlas --out tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-all.ndjson && node sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/build-rg-search-matrix.mjs --input tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-all.ndjson --out tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-rg.ndjson && node sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/embed-chunks.mjs --input tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-rg.ndjson --collection parents_atlas_chunks && node sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/qdrant-tag-backfill.mjs --collection parents_atlas_chunks --from-ndjson tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-rg.ndjson && node sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/hyperrag-expand.mjs --input tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-rg.ndjson --out tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-expanded.ndjson && node sveltekit-frontend/scripts/atlas/topology-project-4d.mjs --input tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-expanded.ndjson --out tmp/chunks/parents-corpus-4d.ndjson
scripts.graph:exports:smoke: npm run graph:exports && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File duckdb\smoke-duckdb.ps1
scripts.start:all-lanes: npm run start:dev:smoke && npm run start:atlas:smoke && npm run start:graphify:smoke
scripts.ingest:packet: node scripts/ingest/rank-cards.mjs && node scripts/ingest/compress-cards.mjs --budget 6000 && node scripts/ingest/build-ace-packet.mjs
scripts.ace:refresh: npm run cards:merge && npm run ace:packets
scripts.recommendations:build: node scripts/ingest/rank-cards.mjs && node scripts/ingest/rerank-cards.mjs && node scripts/ingest/compress-cards.mjs && node scripts/opencode/build-recommendations.mjs
scripts.recommendations:full: npm run recommendations:build && npm run ace:label-and-cache && npm run recommendations:tasks && npm run recommendations:atlas-coverage
scripts.ingest:pipeline: npm run ingest:rank && npm run rerank:cards && npm run ingest:label && npm run ingest:compress && npm run ingest:cache
scripts.ace:label-and-cache: npm run graphify:feature-labels && npm run graphify:domain-topology && npm run ace:intent-cache && npm run ace:cache
scripts.ingest:label: node scripts/ingest/label-features.mjs
scripts.ace:startup: npm run redis:wait && npm run embeds:stub && npm run recommendations:full
scripts.ace:startup:offline: npm run redis:wait:offline && npm run embeds:stub && npm run recommendations:full
